evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked — call moved straight from address confirmation into packing/inventory questions.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — customer gave only matter-of-fact inventory and walk-distance answers, no concern was ever raised to dig into.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'you only pay for the actual [time]' (window) plus 'we're hourly based, so [the less] time the move will take, [the less] money you get [charged], so preparation [pays] for sure' (self-prep tip).

top_strength: Read the customer's readiness cue and moved smoothly into booking the moment she said 'I'm ready to book,' locking the date and getting the unit number without friction.
coaching_note: No agenda question and no differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time, Communication) land anywhere in the call — the booking closed on logistics and price alone, with none of the trust-building script delivered.
